parameters.query:
WITH selected_documents AS (
    SELECT
        d.id,
        d.billing_month,
        d.imported_at,
        d.parser_version,
        d.payload
    FROM energy.utility_documents AS d
    WHERE d.billing_month = ($1::text || '-01')::date
),
receipt_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.id,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'document_id', d.id,
            'billing_month', to_char(d.billing_month, 'YYYY-MM'),
            'imported_at', d.imported_at,
            'parser_version', d.parser_version,

            'meter_readings',
            (
                SELECT COALESCE(
                    jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'resource', r.resource,
                            'meter_number', r.meter_number,
                            'zone', r.zone,
                            'unit', r.unit,
                            'previous_value', r.previous_value,
                            'current_value', r.current_value,
                            'reading_date', r.reading_date
                        )
                        ORDER BY r.zone, r.id
                    ),
                    '[]'::jsonb
                )
                FROM energy.utility_meter_readings AS r
                WHERE r.document_id = d.id
                  AND r.resource = 'electricity'
            ),

            'individual_charges',
            (
                SELECT COALESCE(
                    jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'zone', c.zone,
                            'unit', c.unit,
                            'consumption', c.consumption,
                            'applied_rate', c.applied_rate,
                            'amount', c.amount,
                            'recalculation', c.recalculation,
                            'benefit', c.benefit,
                            'penalty', c.penalty,
                            'payable', c.payable
                        )
                        ORDER BY c.zone, c.id
                    ),
                    '[]'::jsonb
                )
                FROM energy.utility_charges AS c
                WHERE c.document_id = d.id
                  AND c.service = 'electricity'
                  AND c.scope = 'individual'
            ),

            'common_property_charges',
            (
                SELECT COALESCE(
                    jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'zone', c.zone,
                            'unit', c.unit,
                            'consumption', c.consumption,
                            'applied_rate', c.applied_rate,
                            'amount', c.amount,
                            'recalculation', c.recalculation,
                            'benefit', c.benefit,
                            'penalty', c.penalty,
                            'payable', c.payable
                        )
                        ORDER BY c.zone, c.id
                    ),
                    '[]'::jsonb
                )
                FROM energy.utility_charges AS c
                WHERE c.document_id = d.id
                  AND c.service = 'electricity'
                  AND c.scope = 'common_property'
            ),

            'electricity_individual_total',
            d.payload -> 'electricity_individual_total',

            'period_context',
            d.payload -> 'document'
        ) AS receipt
    FROM selected_documents AS d
)
SELECT
    $1::text AS requested_billing_month,

    CASE
        WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'not_found'
        WHEN count(*) = 1 THEN 'found'
        ELSE 'multiple_documents'
    END AS status,

    count(*) AS document_count,

    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(receipt ORDER BY id),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS receipts,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'source', 'imported_utility_receipt',
        'exact_consumption_period_verified', false,
        'rates_are_document_applied_rates', true,
        'tariff_validity_dates_available', false,
        'zone_schedule_available', false,
        'parser_correctness_independently_verified', false
    ) AS limitations

FROM receipt_data;
